slides.headline: what to say when you messed up at work
slides.sub: four things i do before i say it to my team

slides.headline: name the mistake fast
slides.sub: start with the thing itself. “i gave the wrong direction here.”

slides.headline: say it out loud first
slides.sub: i use an app called Steady for this. you talk to an ai person who answers like a real one and pushes back

slides.headline: cut the long excuse
slides.sub: one line of context is enough. then stop. “here’s what i missed.”

slides.headline: say what changes now
slides.sub: give the fix and the next step. “from now on, i’ll put the final call in writing.”

slides.headline: harder for you: owning it or saying it plain?

caption:
when you need to own your mistake with your team, short is kinder than a long excuse.
people can feel when you’re trying to sound better than it was.

save this for the next hard reset talk.

the app is Steady, link in bio.
